verdict.rationale: Codex cloud lets users delegate tasks to run in isolated cloud environments in parallel, triggered from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack, and return later to review results—supporting background/autonomous execution. However, there's no evidence of scheduled/triggered automations running without a user-initiated task (e.g., cron-like recurring jobs), and community feedback focuses on agent quality/UX rather than confirming robust unattended automation.
